```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>7-Day CPU Temperature Chart</title>
    <style>
        body {
            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            height: 100vh;
            margin: 0;
            background-color: #f4f4f4;
        }
        .chart-container {
            width: 800px;
            height: 500px;
            background-color: white;
            border-radius: 8px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
            padding: 20px;
            position: relative;
        }
        canvas {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
        }
        .axis-label {
            position: absolute;
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #333;
        }
        .x-axis-label {
            bottom: 0;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
        }
        .y-axis-label {
            left: 10px;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(-90deg);
        }
        .title {
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 18px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            color: #333;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="chart-container">
        <div class="title">7-Day CPU Temperature (°C)</div>
        <div class="axis-label y-axis-label">Temperature (°C)</div>
        <div class="axis-label x-axis-label">Day</div>
        <canvas id="temperatureChart"></canvas>
    </div>

    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('temperatureChart');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

        // Set canvas resolution to match display size
        canvas.width = 800;
        canvas.height = 450;

        // Data: 7 days of CPU temperatures (randomized between 40-85°C)
        const days = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'];
        const temperatures = Array.from({length: 7}, () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 46) + 40);

        // Chart dimensions
        const padding = 50;
        const chartWidth = canvas.width - 2 * padding;
        const chartHeight = canvas.height - 2 * padding;
        const xStep = chartWidth / (days.length - 1);
        const yMin = 40;
        const yMax = 85;
        const yStep = chartHeight / (yMax - yMin);

        // Draw grid lines
        function drawGrid() {
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#eee';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;

            // Horizontal grid lines
            for (let i = yMin; i <= yMax; i += 5) {
                const y = canvas.height - padding - (i - yMin) * yStep;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(padding, y);
                ctx.lineTo(canvas.width - padding, y);
                ctx.stroke();

                // Y-axis labels
                ctx.fillStyle = '#666';
                ctx.font = '12px Arial';
                ctx.textAlign = 'right';
                ctx.fillText(i, padding - 10, y + 4);
            }

            // Vertical grid lines
            for (let i = 0; i < days.length; i++) {
                const x = padding + i * xStep;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(x, padding);
                ctx.lineTo(x, canvas.height - padding);
                ctx.stroke();

                // X-axis labels
                ctx.fillStyle = '#666';
                ctx.font = '12px Arial';
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.fillText(days[i], x, canvas.height - padding + 20);
            }
        }

        // Draw temperature line
        function drawTemperatureLine() {
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#e74c3c';
            ctx.lineWidth = 3;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(padding, canvas.height - padding - (temperatures[0] - yMin) * yStep);

            for (let i = 1; i < temperatures.length; i++) {
                const x = padding + i * xStep;
                const y = canvas.height - padding - (temperatures[i] - yMin) * yStep;
                ctx.lineTo(x, y);
            }

            ctx.stroke();

            // Draw data points
            ctx.fillStyle = '#e74c3c';
            for (let i = 0; i < temperatures.length; i++) {
                const x = padding + i * xStep;
                const y = canvas.height - padding - (temperatures[i] - yMin) * yStep;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.arc(x, y, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.fill();

                // Display temperature value
                ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
                ctx.font = '12px Arial';
                ctx.textAlign = 'center';
                ctx.fillText(temperatures[i], x, y - 10);
            }
        }

        // Draw chart
        drawGrid();
        drawTemperatureLine();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```
